explication: Apache CarbonData is an indexed columnar data store for analytics, with a separate Agent metadata-storage module. The documented core workflow is to ingest data into CarbonData files with indexes, then use those indexes to prune work and scan encoded columnar data for analytics. The graph also preserves documented streaming, SDK, query-engine integrations, and Agent capabilities. Source excerpts are limited, so detailed runtime call ownership between these subsystems is not established; those connections are shown as unverified where useful.
